Position title: Radiocommunications Technician
Work location: Lyndhurst, VIC 3975
Salary: $79,500 - $100,000

Main task: You will be part of a team that will perform project, installation, and maintenance
works - both in workshops and field locations. The range of technologies will include but not be
limited to, underground leaky feeder radio systems, wide area radio networks, fibre optic and
data networks, Wi-Fi, remote control and monitoring systems, microwave systems and general
electronic repairs.

Responsibilities:
- Form part of our clients on site technical team to maintain various Communication &
Network equipment.
- New systems workshop build, programming, and factory acceptance testing.
- On Site Installation, Commissioning and fault finding of Voice & Data Radio systems
predominantly Motorola.
- On Site Installation, Commissioning and fault finding of microwave equipment and
various IP based ancillary equipment.
- On Site Installation, Commissioning and fault finding of Rajant Mesh equipment and
networks.
- On Site Installation, Commissioning and fault finding of communications equipment in a
wide variety of locations, including buildings, towers, mobile plant and vehicles.
- Liaise with key stakeholders to ensure project delivery is completed as per design, within
budget, and schedule expectations.
- Completion of Preventative Maintenance Inspections of customer equipment when due.
- Complete Project documentation, Survey reports, FAT and SAT documentation where
required.
- Provide technical input to support sales where required.
- Ensure all activities undertaken are carried out in accordance with company safety and
quality policies and procedures.
- Participate in a 24/7 on call roster on call support for specified customers to meet
contractual SLA’s.

To be suitable for this position you require the following:
- Holder of a diploma or any relevant qualification
- At least 2 years of relevant work experience
- Interest in RF, Electronics, ICT, Networking and various other Technologies.
- Sound written and verbal communication skills.
- Self-motivation and excellent time management skills.
- Ability to learn new information quickly.
- Intermediate to advanced computer literacy.
- Willingness to travel for extended periods of time within VIC and interstate.
- A good understanding and commitment to safety

result.description:
VeiraMal Consulting is seeking an experienced ICT Support Technicians NEC to join our clients' business D Power Australia Pty Ltd in Tarneit. Our client is looking for an enthusiastic individual who can work well in a team, with strong communication skills.

Aim of the role:

- To provide efficient and reliable ICT support across hardware, software, and network systems. 
- To ensure smooth day-to-day operation of ICT systems and assist users with technical issues. 
- To support the implementation, maintenance, and improvement of computer systems and applications. 

Responsible for: Maintaining effective ICT support services and ensuring optimal performance of systems, networks, and equipment. 

Accountable to: IT Manager / Operations Manager 

Performance appraisal: Three months after appointment, then at least annually and/or when required. 

Job Descriptions:

- Determining software and hardware requirements and providing solutions to technical problems. 
- Responding to queries and support requests related to software, hardware, and system issues. 
- Installing, configuring, and downloading appropriate software and applications. 
- Adapting existing programs and systems to meet user requirements. 
- Ensuring efficient use of applications, systems, and ICT equipment. 
- Implementing, maintaining, and supporting computer networks and systems. 
- Designing, updating, and maintaining websites and online systems where required. 
- Repairing and replacing peripheral equipment such as printers, terminals, and modems. 
- Providing support via help desk or call centre systems, including logging and tracking issues. 
- Setting up user accounts, permissions, and system access rights. 
- Assisting with system upgrades, patches, and maintenance activities. 
- Monitoring system performance and escalating complex technical issues when required. 
- Supporting data backups, recovery procedures, and ICT security compliance. 
- Providing guidance and basic training to users on systems and applications. 
- Maintaining accurate records of support activities, incidents, and resolutions. 

Requirements:

- Experience in ICT support, help desk, or technical support roles. 
- Strong knowledge of computer hardware, software, and troubleshooting. 
- Understanding of basic networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi). 
- Ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently. 
- Strong communication and customer service skills. 
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
- Good problem-solving and time management skills. 

Qualifications/Experience:

- Experience in ICT support or technical help desk environment. 
- Qualifications in Information Technology or related field (preferred). 
- Familiarity with Microsoft Windows, Microsoft 365, and ICT systems. 
- Understanding of IT service management and support processes. 

Remuneration: $75,000.00 - $85,000.00 + Super 

Location: Kiosk 2, Riverdale Village Shopping Centre, Davis Road, Tarneit, Victoria, 3029

If you are interested and think you will be a good fit for this role, please apply.

Your Opportunity
We are seeking talented individuals to join our External Audit practise at KPMG.  We are open to full-time/part-time/casual/max-term/flexible working options.

IT External Audit
Our IT External Audit team assists our clients to meet their IT External audit requirements and timelines. We work as an integrated business and as part of a larger multi-disciplinary team. The team draws on a diverse and dedicated group of people, powerful KPMG methodologies, innovating capability and assets, and global resources to support our clients in achieving the right milestones. 

Audit & Assurance: External Audit
Our Audit teams provide value to our clients by delivering specialised quality audit and assurance services. High-quality, independent financial statement audits are essential to maintaining investor confidence. Our audit professionals are committed to the public interest, challenging assumptions, and unlocking valuable insights based on a solid understanding of an organisation’s business and industry.

How are you extraordinary?
•	You are analytically minded and enjoy applying structured thinking and analysis techniques to complex problems. 
•	You are a kind and compassionate leader with a passion for continually growing your leadership skills to get the best out of a diverse and multidisciplinary team.
•	You are a people-person with a love of sharing your Audit and Assurance insight and tailoring your communication appropriately for subject matter experts and clients who want to learn more.

Your Experience
To be considered for this opportunity, your qualifications, skills & experience could include:

IT External Audit
•	Experience in assisting clients meet their IT External audit requirements and timelines.
•	Supporting engagements in the preparation of clear and concise IT External Audit reports. 
•	Providing technical knowledge, direction, and training to engagement team members.
•	In a leadership role, manage small teams and oversee the planning and execution of IT External Audit client engagements
•	Supporting business proposals and business development activities by assisting in the identification of new target clients, building business relationships, and developing/presenting proposals/findings
•	An innovative mindset and passion for problem solving enabled through technology.

Audit & Assurance: External Audit
•	Experience leading, managing and executing advisory related engagements of high-profile clients and all aspects of audit delivery, client service and business development.
•	Providing technical knowledge, direction, and training to engagement team members.
•	Experience working across Private and Corporate clients is desired.
•	Qualifications in CA/CPA and CISA/CISM/CRISC, and strong IFRS skills, will be viewed favourably.

Please note, the salary ranges $60k - $100k+ with respect to your level of experience.

result.description:
Australian Fishing Enterprises (AFE) is the largest exporter of Southern Bluefin Tuna in Australia. Our tuna is exported around the world for sale in international marketplaces as a premium sushi/ sashimi product. We specialise in the fishing, ranching and grow out of Southern Bluefin Tuna and control the entire process from catching, feeding, harvesting, processing and delivery. 

JOB SUMMARY:
The Vessel Master will carry out duties as directed by the General Manager or Farm Managers.

Approximate start date: December 2026 & January 2027, AFE will be taking successful candidates throughout 2026/27 for these positions. Employment may be up to 4 years.

Renumeration:
The position is a Award Hourly Rate or Salary, paid on a fortnightly basis.
Vessel work completed inshore and onshore will be calculated at the nominated Farm rate.
(https://www.fairwork.gov.au/employment-conditions/awards/awards-summary/ma000114-summary)(https://awards.fairwork.gov.au/MA000114.html)
An additional contract is put in place to cover the periods offshore for Tow & Support (if applicable).


Operations:
Periods at sea are varied and weather dependent. Hours of operation are determined by the daily operational needs. Farm vessels can be required to conduct operations year round from land based sites out to the farming site. The season begins in December finishing with the annual harvest period throughout June, July & August.
January – July Operations are 7 days per week; you can work up to 6 days in a week. Up to 12 hours per day.
August to December Operations are 5 days per week Monday to Friday, you will work up to 5 days in a week, 8 hours per day.

Vessel Master Duties:
The Employee will be required to perform certain duties whilst Master of the Vessel. Although this list is not exhaustive, it is a generalised overview of duties.
•	Ensure crew work in such a way, to minimize risks to their health, safety, and others.
•	Being involved in and overseeing the induction and ongoing training of crew and ensure safe work practices are continually developed and maintained. Ensure that all training is recorded on communication forms and passed on to the Farm Manager.
•	Ensuring that only employees and approved maintenance contractors come onboard or attend any work sites. 
•	Documenting bait received, fed out, uneaten feed and daily fish behaviour. 
•	Report daily to the Farm Manager.
•	Directing and training crew on feeding in accordance with daily feed plans and correct feeding techniques.
•	Working the vessel within the regulations and relevant fisheries management rules. Ensuring that you are familiar with restricted areas regarding other farming operations, fisheries licensing conditions, national parks and within the bounds of safe and good seamanship. 
•	Keeping the vessel clean, tidy, and safe with safety and spare equipment accessible and organized.
•	Ensuring the engine room is operating properly.  The skipper is ultimately responsible for the whole vessel.
•	Routinely checking all is in order and secure and dry in the chain locker, void spaces, bilge, steering compartment etc. (This is just basic seamanship and neglecting this responsibility is not acceptable).
•	Routinely checking lifting gear is in a safe state (blocks, wire, ropes, shackles, hoses).
•	Ensuring vessel is berthed properly and manned sufficiently, not leaving inexperienced deckhands to be responsible for securing the vessel. 
•	Ensuring all necessary gear, oils, jobs etc. are ordered and performed in a timely manner
•	Carry out farm maintenance and repairs as required by The Farm Manager.
•	Assisting in transfer of tuna to farms
•	Assisting in general tuna farm duties including feeding, harvesting, processing and maintenance.
•	Ensuring own qualifications are kept up to date.
•	Maintaining Ship’s Log daily as per statutory requirements and farm requirements. Entries should include date, position, weather, personnel on board, departure times, names of current crew at the commencement of each trip, fuel/water/oil taken on and any other relevant information should be properly recorded to be able to refer to it later.

MASTERS’s SAFETY RESPONSIBILITIES
•	Ensure that health and safety are taken into account when new or changed methods, processes, products, harmful substances are implemented
•	Provide proper instructions and training in health and safety for new Crew and for Crew redeployed into new jobs.
•	Take the necessary precautions, (so far as reasonably practical,) to protect contractors and members of the public whilst on company vessels & premises.
•	Ensure all accidents reported are fully investigated and the appropriate corrective action has been taken. Set the example for compliance with the safety policy and maintain a continued involvement, interest and enthusiasm in the health and safety programme.
•	Ensure the necessary checklists are in use to help provide a safe work environment at all work sites and that the required frequency of checking is maintained.
•	Ensure that effective induction is provided to all new and transferred Crew and that an induction checklist specific to each work site is developed, maintained, and used.

Vessel Inductions:

All crew are inducted onto the vessel prior to departure. 
Safety drills conducted Bi-monthly
Deck Machinery training and instruction conducted 
SOP’s to be discussed for operations 

QUALIFICATIONS:
All applicants must possess the following valid certifications:
AMSA certified Master
